verdict.rationale: Moneybird documents an MCP server, CLI, API and webhooks that let an agent reach the administration, but these are building blocks; nothing documents ledger monitoring, spend-anomaly flagging, or duplicate-transaction detection. The only duplicate feature covers possible duplicate contacts, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close
